action.prompt:
A file in packages/ was just saved. Before continuing, verify the Skeleton Crew boundary rules from .kiro/steering/skeleton-crew-rules.md:
1. Does any packages/* file now import from apps/*? If yes, flag it immediately.
2. Does packages/core import from any other package in packages/*? If yes, flag it immediately.
3. Has any application-specific string (e.g. 'ReflectionFeed', 'DevRecall') been hardcoded into packages/api logic rather than read from an environment variable? If yes, flag it immediately.
If all checks pass, state 'Skeleton boundary: OK' and continue.

A .gitignore file was just saved. Check whether it contains any entry that would exclude the .kiro directory or any of its subdirectories (e.g. '.kiro', '.kiro/', '.kiro/**'). If any such entry exists, alert immediately: 'WARNING: .kiro is being excluded from git. This violates the project conventions and hackathon requirements. Remove the exclusion.' The .kiro directory must always be committed to the repository.
